did: Built MD7: My data on the phone now has a Korean word sets page. Each read-aloud word set shows when it was added, when it was first opened and how many sentences it has, with Archive, and Bring back for archived ones. An archived set leaves Read aloud and Ready for you and frees its place under the 50, but nothing is deleted: its deck, every count on its sentences and each word's pace stay on the phone, and an older phone's sets load unchanged. Only you archive a set (C232); a set first opened a month or more ago carries a hint. Opening its routine scene again, or picking its file again, brings an archived set back.

calls.title: What the hint on an old word set says
options: First opened a month or more ago
calls.why: The phone keeps only a set's first open, so 'not opened in a while' would claim more than it knows.

calls.title: Opening an archived set's routine scene brings it back
options: bring the set back, keeping its first open
read it while it stays archived
calls.why: Opening the scene is reading it again, and a set read but archived would be out of Read aloud while in use.

left: Picking a set that is in use again from a file still resets its first open and added dates. That's old behaviour, filed on #2265 as an unlisted discard site, not changed here.
No screens of the page: the phone build doesn't render in a desktop browser and the ui-fit harness doesn't reach the route. Its jsdom test draws it.
